statement: Full profinite peripheral recognition and type(0,4) finite geometric recognition are false: an explicit inverse-pair pants construction equips the Haran torsion-free index-two extension with a complete preserved four-cusp structure and a mixed-prime multiplier.
where_proved: Part D, statement D.29; code/part_a/haran_rank3.py and code/part_b/haran_quotient_independent_audit.py
depends_on: A.2; A.7; D.1; D.16; D.21; D.26; D.27; Harbater--Schneps MainTheorem(a) and TheoremA
depends_on_doubtful_reading: 353: comme or connu; inserted sans torsion is satisfied; the false full-profinite assertion is refuted with its loop hypothesis retained
notes: Exact free-basis isomorphism b'=tau(a) identifies the new extension with D.26, resolving its arbitrary marking positively. The normalized Galois pants isomorphism has prescribed multiplier but is not required to have finite order. Its inverse is used on the other pants piece. All four peripheral conjugacy comparisons, twisted group law, torsion-free retraction, order18 quotient, and the empty fixed sets are proved.
